scripts.check: svelte-check --workspace client && tsc --noEmit && oxfmt --check && oxlint client src tests *.js *.mjs *.config.ts *.config.js *.config.mjs
scripts.check:ci: svelte-check --workspace client && tsc --noEmit && oxfmt --check --threads=1 && oxlint --threads=1 client src tests *.js *.mjs *.config.ts *.config.js *.config.mjs
scripts.e2e: node scripts/writeWranglerConfig.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply ypad-db --local && playwright test
scripts.e2e:screenshot: node scripts/writeWranglerConfig.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply ypad-db --local && playwright test manual
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/writeWranglerConfig.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply ypad-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:prod: node scripts/writeWranglerConfig.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply ypad-db --remote
scripts.cf:deploy: node scripts/writeWranglerConfig.mjs && vite build && wrangler deploy
